bio.text: John Deaton is a Republican candidate for U.S. Senate in Massachusetts in 2026; he launched his campaign in November 2025.
He is an attorney and U.S. Marine Corps veteran who unsuccessfully challenged Sen. Elizabeth Warren in 2024.
WBUR reported in November 2025 that he lived in Bolton, Massachusetts, having moved from Rhode Island in 2024.
